verdicts.reason: Both use the same leaderboard layout: the headline reads well, but the cooling-tower photo is shrunk to a tiny thumbnail and the refinery image is reduced to an unreadable sliver. There is a black bar fragment clipped at the top-left, stray dots drift into the empty right third, and nearly all the original's imagery is lost. B is slightly worse because its dot cluster runs into the photo's right edge, while A keeps the dots clear of it.
